en.title: House of the Dragon Season 3: What to Watch While You Wait
en.summary: The wait for the Targaryen civil war's return is long, but thankfully, Westeros isn't the only place for dragons and drama. We've got your binge-watching needs covered.
en.body:
The dragons have flown, the battles have raged, and now, the long wait for **House of the Dragon** Season 3 has officially begun. HBO's critically acclaimed prequel is taking its time, with a projected return in June 2026, leaving fans with a two-year chasm to fill. For those who can't get enough of the intricate Targaryen family tree, the brutal dance of succession, and the sheer spectacle of Westeros in turmoil, this hiatus can feel like an eternity. Fortunately, the world of premium television is rich with shows and movies that capture similar themes of power, betrayal, and epic fantasy.

If you're craving more of the political machinations and character-driven conflicts that made **House of the Dragon** a runaway success, look no further than its direct predecessor, **Game of Thrones**. The original series laid the groundwork for the Targaryen saga, offering a sprawling narrative filled with morally complex characters and devastating plot twists. For those who prefer their fantasy with a touch more magic and monster-slaying, **The Witcher** on Netflix provides a compelling blend of monster hunts, destiny, and political intrigue, driven by a charismatic lead performance. Beyond these obvious choices, delving into shows like **The Last Kingdom** offers a gritty, historical drama with complex loyalties, while **Vikings** explores the brutal realities of conquest and family feuds. For a more contained, yet equally intense, exploration of power struggles, **Succession** might surprise you with its modern-day parallels to the ruthless pursuit of control, albeit without the dragons.

## Beyond the Seven Kingdoms

The beauty of the fantasy and drama genres is their sheer breadth. Shows like **Arcane**, with its stunning animation and intricate lore, offer a different kind of epic storytelling. For those who enjoy the darker, more mature themes, **The Wheel of Time** brings Robert Jordan's beloved book series to life, featuring a vast world and a prophecy-driven narrative. If it's the sheer scale and visual splendor you miss, films like Peter Jackson's **The Lord of the Rings** trilogy remain unparalleled benchmarks in epic fantasy filmmaking. Even shows that lean more into character studies, such as **The Crown**, can satisfy the craving for intricate power dynamics and the weight of legacy, just on a different kind of throne.

## What's Next for the Dragons

While we navigate the drought of new **House of the Dragon** episodes, remember that Season 3 is confirmed to be in production, promising more Targaryen drama and, undoubtedly, more dragons. Until then, these curated selections should provide ample entertainment, keeping your passion for epic storytelling alive until the fires of Westeros ignite once more.

content_raw: Fans of the HBO epic series are unfortunately looking at a two-year wait until Season 4 premieres
